name: ACCESS.com
positioning: AI website builder and interactive listing-presentation platform for real estate agents, with IDX and CRM integration.
description: ACCESS.com is a website and marketing platform for individual real estate agents and teams. It provides a drag-and-drop website builder with professionally designed themes, an interactive digital listing-presentation and open-house builder, and a matching print and digital marketing-materials suite, with IDX and CRM integration and an AI assistant layered across the products.
real_estate_use: An agent or small team needs a branded website and a listing presentation ready before a listing appointment, without hiring a designer or waiting on a web agency. They pick a theme, connect their IDX feed and CRM, and generate an interactive digital presentation or open-house page for a specific property from the same platform.
features: Drag-and-drop real estate website builder with designed themes
Interactive digital listing-presentation and open-house builder
AI assistant for site and content customization

use_cases.job: Launch a branded agent website without a designer or developer
Build an interactive digital listing presentation for a specific property or open house

capabilities: AI assistant for website and content customization
AI-powered lead hub and smart chat assistant for site visitors
